title: A1-15 · Family and professions; the healthy plural

blocks.text: A1-15 · Family and professions; the healthy plural
Lesson overview

⁧مُهَنْدِسُونَ⁩ • Engineers • ⁧مُهَنْدِسَاتٌ⁩ • Engineer • ⁧طُلَّابٌ⁩ The Arabic form the plural in two ways. The healthy plural adds a desinence (-ūna, -āt) and leave the word intact; The plural over change the word from within. In this unity you learn the healthy plural, a first group of plural traits and the most important rule of agreement of Arabic grammar: the plurals of things agree to the singular feminine. The vocabulary is that of the professions and family.

rows: 6–7 hours · one week (week 36 of the calendar)

blocks.text: Materials This unit, Anki deck A1 (tag A1-15), script for speech synthesis
Targets. At the end of the lesson you know:
1. form the healthy male plural (-ūna / -īna) and female (-ātun / -ātin);
2. to recognize the most frequent plurals and learn them with the singular;
3. to give adjectives, verbs and pronouns with plurals of people and things;
4. use ⁧هٰؤُلَاءِ⁩ for people and ⁧هٰذِهِ⁩ for things in the plural;
5. name about twenty professions and describe your work and that of your colleagues and family members.
Plan of the week.

rows: Dialog · section 1: the healthy male plural · lexicon (first half)
Section 2: the healthy female plural · exercises 1–2
Section 4: the agreement of the plurals · years 4–5

blocks.text: 7 Unit verification · module review A1.3
1. Dialogue · An interview at work
Laylā prepares an article on women in the Italian police and interview Hudā.

rows: ⁧لَيْلَى: مَا عَمَلُكِ فِي المَرْكَزِ يَا هُدَى؟⁩
Laylā: mā ʿamaluki fī l-markazi yā Hudā?
Laylā: What work do you do at the police station, Hudā?
Hudā: anā šurṭiyya. aʿmalu fī farīqin ṣaġīrin maʿa ḍābiṭayni wa-mutarǧimayn.
HudāI'm a cop. I work in a small team with two officers and two interpreters.
Laylā: hal fī l-markazi šurṭiyyātun kaṯīrāt?
Laylā: Are there many policemen at the police station?
Hudā: Yes, and some are official.
Laylā: What about the interpreters? Where did they come from?
⁧المُتَرْجِمُونَ مِنْ بِلَادٍ⁩ : ⁧هُدَى⁩ ⁧مِنَ المَغْرِبِ وَمِصْرَ⁩ : ⁧مُخْتَلِفَةٍ⁩ . ⁧هُمْ مُهِمُّونَ جِدًّا لِعَمَلِنَا⁩ . ⁧وَسُورِيَا⁩
Hudā: al-mutarǧimūna min bilādin muḫtalifa: mina l-Maġribi wa-Miṣra wa- Sūriyā. hum muhimmūna ǧiddan li- ʿamalinā.
Hudā: Interpreters come from different countries: Morocco, Egypt and Syria. They're very important to our work.
Laylā: And the job is difficult?
Hudā: aḥyānan. as-sāʿātu ṭawīlatun, lākini z-zumalāʾu mumtāzūn.
Hudā: Sometimes. Times (Lett. The hours) are long, but colleagues are excellent.

blocks.text: What to notice. For people the adjective is plural: ⁧شُرْطِيَّاتٌ كَثِيرَاتٌ⁩ , ⁧المُتَرْجِمُونَ مُهِمُّونَ⁩ , ⁧الزُّمَلَاءُ مُمْتَازُونَ⁩ . For things it's female singular: ⁧بِلَادٍ مُخْتَلِفَةٍ⁩ • different countries • ⁧السَّاعَاتُ طَوِيلَةٌ⁩ The hours are long. ⁧ضَابِطَيْنِ⁩ and ⁧مُتَرْجِمَيْنِ⁩ They're dual to the genitive after ⁧مَعَ⁩ ( A1-12).
2. The healthy male plural
It is used for men (or mixed groups) indicated by participles, adjectives and nisba: ⁧مُدَرِّس⁩ , ⁧مُهَنْدِس⁩ , ⁧مُوَظَّف⁩ , ⁧مِصْرِيّ⁩ ,
⁧مَشْغُول⁩ .

Two cases, not three. The healthy male and dual plural have a form for the name and one for all other cases: -ūna/-īna, -āni/-ayni. Pause: -ūn , -īn . Without ⁧ن⁩ iniḍāfa and with the suffixes (recognize): ⁧مُوَظَّفُو الوِزَارَةِ⁩ • the employees of the Ministry • ⁧مُدَرِّسُوكَ⁩ Your teachers will be ⁧مَعَ مُوَظَّفِي البَنْكِ⁩ With bank employees. The final alif of ⁧مُوَظَّفُو⁩ It's not pronounced. It doesn't apply to all male names. ⁧طَالِب⁩ , ⁧طَبِيب⁩ , ⁧زَمِيل⁩ , ⁧رَجُل⁩ they have multiple fractures (section 4). Male healthy plural is typical of the words that begin with ⁧مُـ⁩ (participants) and nisba.
3. The healthy female plural
It forms by removing the ⁧ة⁩ and adding -āt .

The accusative in -i. It is the only exception to the system of cases that you have seen so far: in the female plural the accusative has not -a but -i, like the genitive. ⁧أَعْرِفُ المُدَرِّسَاتِ⁩ , not ⁧المدرساتَ⁩ ». Not just women. -āt form the plural of many words in ⁧ة⁩ ( ⁧سَيَّارَات⁩ , ⁧جَامِعَات⁩ , ⁧وِزَارَات⁩ , ⁧مُشْكِلَات⁩ ), of some male ( ⁧اِجْتِمَاعَات⁩ , ⁧مَطَارَات⁩ , ⁧حِوَارَات⁩ ) and almost all foreign words ( ⁧تِلِفِزْيُونَات⁩ • Televisions). It is the plural reserve of modern language.
4. Pluralities
Many names form the plural changing vowels and internal structure, starting from the same root. The schemes are numerous; The most frequent ones are recognized soon.
⁧مَدْرَسَة⁩ ⁧مَدَارِس⁩ mafāʿil school

How to learn them. The plural over is learned together with the singular: in the vocabulary of this volume it is always indicated, and in Anki the paper reports it. With time you will recognize the patterns and you can guess many plurals; the complete analysis of the schemes is in A2 and B1. Diptotes. Some schemes (fuʿalāʾ, afʿilāʾ, mafāʿil) do not take tanwīn and to the indeterminate genitive have -a: ⁧مِنْ زُمَلَاءَ⁩ , ⁧فِي مَكَاتِبَ⁩ ( A1-08).
5. The agreement of the parties

rows: The students are new. (two possible plurals)
The books are on the table, and they're hard.

blocks.text: . ⁧الدُّرُوسُ تَبْدَأُ صَبَاحًا⁩ / ⁧الطُّلَّابُ يَدْرُسُونَ⁩ Students study / classes start in the morning.

Because. For Arabic grammar a set of things is perceived as a unique mass, treated as a singular feminine. Remember this every time you read a plural: ...person or what? The rule also applies to healthy plurals of things: ⁧الوِزَارَاتُ مُهِمَّةٌ⁩ The ministries are important. Adjectives for people in the plural can be healthy or between: ⁧كَبِير⁩ → ⁧كِبَار⁩ , ⁧جَدِيد⁩ → ⁧جُدُد⁩ . If you do not know the plural over, the healthy plural ( ⁧جَدِيدُونَ⁩ ) is generally understandable, but in the vocabulary you find the most used form.
6. The professions

⁧مُحَامٍ⁩ and ⁧قَاضٍ⁩ . No article ends in tanwīn -in; with the article have -ī: ⁧المُحَامِي⁩ , ⁧القَاضِي⁩ . It is the 'defective' model of ⁧مَقْهًى⁩ and ⁧مَبْنًى⁩ , with the i in place of a. The female is regular: ⁧مُحَامِيَة⁩ , ⁧قَاضِيَة⁩ . Working as... in Arabic is said to be ⁧أَعْمَلُ مُحَاسِبًا⁩ "work as an accountant" or simply ⁧أَنَا مُحَاسِبٌ⁩ .
7. Pronunciation

-ūna / -īna. The difference is in the long vowel: mudarrisūna / mudarrisīna . Pause -ūn / -īn : Here ū and ī Well, that's very distinct. -ātun / -ātin. muhandisātun , maʿa muhandisātin : ā It's long and it has an accent. The doubles of the plurals over. ⁧طُلَّاب⁩ ṭullāb , ⁧ضُبَّاط⁩ ḍubbāṭ , ⁧تُجَّار⁩ tuǧǧār , ⁧عُمَّال⁩ ʿummāl : the double central consonant is the sign of the scheme fuʿʿāl. ⁧ض⁩ and ⁧ط⁩ in ⁧ضَابِط⁩ . Two emphasis in the same word: ḍābiṭ , plural ḍubbāṭ .
8. New lexicon

Notes of use. ⁧وَظِيفَة⁩ is the job (seeking work = ⁧البَحْثُ عَنْ وَظِيفَةٍ⁩ ); ⁧عَمَل⁩ is work as activity. ⁧سَاعَة⁩ means "hour" and "clock" (A1-17). The plural ⁧هٰؤُلَاءِ⁩ is written with the short alif on ⁧هـ⁩ , as ⁧هٰذَا⁩ . ⁧مُحَلِّل⁩ is the analyst in any field: ⁧مُحَلِّلٌ سِيَاسِيٌّ⁩ • political analyst • ⁧مُحَلِّلٌ مَالِيٌّ⁩ Financial analysts are not included.
9. Examples in context

rows: yaʿmalu l-muḥallilūna fī ṭ- ṭābiqi ṯ-ṯāliṯ.
Analysts work on the third floor.
I work as a programmer in a small company.
The lawyer's with the judge now.

Write about 60 words: your work ( ⁧أَعْمَلُ⁩ … ⁧فِي⁩ ...), your colleagues and their professions (at least three plurals), the professions in your family, a sentence with ⁧هٰؤُلَاءِ⁩ and one with a plural of things tuned to the singular female.
